name: MostiCon
blurb: A family-friendly pop-culture convention in the Mostviertel region, covering comics, anime, manga, K-pop and gaming at Messehalle Wieselburg.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Mosti26 ... Von 05 - 06 Dezember 2026' and 'Die Mosti26 startet in 61 Tagen' (countdown matching Dec 5-6, 2026, measured from the Oct 4, 2026 render), at 'Location Messehalle Wieselburg Eingang: Halle 9'.

notes: Homepage explicitly says 'Programm Coming soon', so guests/lineup are not yet announced. No organizer company name is shown (only '...designed with heart by the MostiCon Team').
